topic: miniaudio Device Initialization and Callback Pattern
extracted_claim: miniaudio uses config/init pattern: ma_device_config_init(ma_device_type_playback) → set config members → ma_device_init(context, &config, &device) → ma_device_start(&device). Data delivered asynchronously via dataCallback function. Never stop/start device from inside callback (deadlock). Sample formats: ma_format_f32, ma_format_s16, ma_format_s24, ma_format_s32, ma_format_u8. All transparent structures (no opaque handles).
implementation_relevance: HSE has no audio. miniaudio is the standard single-header C audio library for games.

extracted_claim: miniaudio high level API: ma_engine wraps ma_resource_manager (loading/streaming sounds) + ma_node_graph (mixing/effects). ma_engine_init(NULL, &engine) creates engine with internal device. ma_engine_play_sound(&engine, "file.wav", NULL) plays inline sound. ma_sound_init_from_file() creates reusable sound object with flags: MA_SOUND_FLAG_DECODE (pre-decode), MA_SOUND_FLAG_ASYNC (async load), MA_SOUND_FLAG_NO_PITCH, MA_SOUND_FLAG_NO_SPATIALIZATION. Spatialization: positioning, attenuation (none/inverse/linear/exponential), Doppler, cones. Sound groups organize sounds (sfx/voice/music) with independent volume.
implementation_relevance: ma_engine provides complete game audio in ~10 lines of code.

document_reference: miniaudio.h, Section 1.1, Context and Device Enumeration
extracted_claim: ma_context sits above devices (1 context : N devices). ma_context_init(backends, backendCount, config) initializes. ma_context_get_devices() returns ma_device_info arrays with id and name. Device types: playback, capture, duplex, loopback (WASAPI only). Passing NULL context to ma_device_init creates internal context.
implementation_relevance: Context abstraction enables multi-device support and backend selection.
